name: stepup-functions
description: StepUp Thapar campus fitness - Cloud Functions backend (Firebase v2, TypeScript)

scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-stepup --only firestore,auth "jest --config jest.emulator.config.js --runInBand test/emulator/callables"
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-stepup --only firestore,storage "jest --config jest.emulator.config.js --runInBand test/emulator/rules"
scripts.test:functions-e2e: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-stepup --only auth,functions,firestore "jest --config jest.emulator.config.js --runInBand test/emulator/e2e"
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:emulator && npm run test:rules
